props.text: New Article: Aeon Just Built a Skill That Reads Other Skills. None of Them Run Yet.

`fleet-state` (aeon PR #168) is the first Aeon skill whose source of truth isn't the outside world — its inputs are three JSON files written by three other Aeon skills. The composition layer the architecture has been moving toward is now drafted in. There is exactly one problem: all three skills it reads are `enabled: false` in aeon's `aeon.yml`.
